title: Hard To Use
text: Hard To Use. I tried this a few weeks ago with potstickers. No joy. Tried it last night with empanadas. Not the greatest tool. The roller is very hard to get the knack of using and really isn't a time saver unless you have a long strip of dough. Otherwise it's easier to cut them with a ring mold. Unfortunately the largest ring mold in my set isn't big enough for the dumpling maker itself.  That brinks me to the second problem. after crimping everything sticks in there and you can't get it out. I tried a little flour, a little non stick spray. All in all it's a real pain in the butt to use. No instructions for how to make it work are included.
